name: cf-templates-zenpay-checkout-backend
description: A starter backend for ZenPay's hosted checkout plugin: signs each payment, receives and verifies ZenPay's callbacks, stores every payment in D1 and shows them in an admin panel behind Cloudflare Access.

scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run db:migrate && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm run typegen:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run

DB.description: Stores every payment attempt and every callback ZenPay sends for it. `pnpm run deploy` applies its tables (migrations/).

CHECKOUT_LIMITER.description: Caps each visitor at 10 checkout requests a minute.

STATUS_LIMITER.description: Caps each visitor at 60 payment status checks a minute.

CALLBACK_LIMITER.description: Caps the callbacks that do not verify at 60 a minute for each payment, so junk posted to one payment's address cannot flood the others. A callback that verifies is never counted.

BRAND_NAME.description: Company name shown in the admin panel.

RETENTION_DAYS.description: How many days a payment and its callbacks are kept after its state last changed, for example `30`. A daily job deletes older ones. A whole number above 0; more than 3650 counts as 3650, and anything else counts as 30.

ZENPAY_CHECKOUT_URL.description: The ZenPay hosted checkout address, for example `https://pay.sandbox.travelpay.com.au/online/v5` for the sandbox. For live payments, ask ZenPay for your program's live address.

ZENPAY_MERCHANT_CODE.description: Your ZenPay merchant code. The checkout API answers 500 until it is set.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Origins of the website that shows the Pay button, separated by commas, for example `https://shop.example.com`. The checkout API answers 403 to every request until it is set.

REDIRECT_URL.description: The page on your shop where the shopper lands after paying, for example `https://shop.example.com/thanks`. The checkout API answers 500 until it is set.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, for example `https://menethil.cloudflareaccess.com`. The admin panel stays locked until this and `ACCESS_AUD` are set.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Application Audience (AUD) Tag of the Access application that protects `/admin`.

ZENPAY_API_KEY.description: Your ZenPay API key. Used in the checkout fingerprint and the callback check, and returned to the shopper's page because ZenPay's plugin needs it.

ZENPAY_USERNAME.description: Your ZenPay username. Used only on the server, inside the checkout fingerprint and the callback check.

ZENPAY_PASSWORD.description: Your ZenPay password. Used only on the server, inside the checkout fingerprint and the callback check.

CALLBACK_TOKEN_SECRET.description: A long random string of your own, at least 32 bytes, that signs each payment's callback address. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
